title: This Android browser now doubles as a travel eSIM
summary: You can set up data before takeoff and activate it on arrival.
body: TL;DR Opera for Android now lets travelers buy and manage an eSIM directly inside the browser. The eSIM works across the entire phone, supports 47 destinations, and lets you top up between stops. Users in 11 launch markets can claim 3GB of free data for three days without entering payment details. The airport is a terrible place to discover that your carrier’s roaming rates are brutal. You just landed, but need to access Maps, arrange a ride, or send a quick message home, and suddenly you’re hunting for Wi-Fi or figuring out a local SIM. Travel eSIMs have made that ritual much easier , and Opera now wants to remove another step by putting one directly inside its Android browser. Opera for Android now lets users buy, install, and manage a travel eSIM without downloading a dedicated eSIM app. The connection works across the entire phone, not just inside Opera, so apps like WhatsApp, Maps, and Uber can use it too. Opera says its eSIM supports 47 destinations and can connect to 5G where local networks allow it.
